caption: Common Lux questions can be traced to specific editor systems and preference layers.

caption: Lux can be active while brightness, light radius or viewport conditions prevent an obvious visible result.
alt: Lux active but dim versus correctly configured light.
capture_instructions: Capture two screenshots of the same perspective viewport with the Lux icon blue: one with near-zero Intensity or tiny radius leaving the scene dark, another with a useful value lighting nearby surfaces. Show the relevant dropdown controls and labels.

caption: Troubleshooting follows the native toolbar, viewport resolution, transient light and renderer layers.

caption: A safe manual Lux update replaces the entire plugin folder rather than mixing files from multiple versions.
alt: Lux project plugin folder ready for a complete update.
capture_instructions: Capture File Explorer showing YourProject/Plugins/Lux with Lux.uplugin, Source, Resources and Content. Include a simple note that the Unreal Editor is closed and the full folder is replaced.

caption: Lux updates affect editor plugin files while personal preferences and project settings remain separate.
alt: Lux release update and configuration ownership diagram.
